Following the Matou faction's defeat in the Fifth Holy Grail War, Sakura Matou is sent into the night as a vessel to conceive the seed of the next generation's mage. Locking away her feelings for her beloved "Senpai," she blends into the Halloween crowds clad in the daringly exposed "Dangerous Beast" costume. When a hesitant whisper of "Trick or Treat" catches a stranger's eye, she is dragged by the arm into a deserted back alley; overwhelmed by his raw, potent presence, she tells herself it is all for the Matou family as she surrenders her lips and body to his demands. Yet once ignited, her flesh refuses to stay confined to mere duty. Hiding her face behind a black mask and "Jirai-kei" fashion, she begins luring him into love hotels, parting her thighs of her own accord. Drenched again and again by his bottomless lust, her guilt dissolves into waves of ecstasy until her original mission is forgotten, leaving her a helpless captive to pleasure. Even after she conceives his child, her swollen belly only drives their secret liaisons to darker extremes: wearing nothing but a collar, she is led completely bare into a park at night, milk dripping from her heavy breasts as the suffocating thrill of potential discovery fuels their feverish outdoor coupling. Just as her breathless moans and the sound of slapping flesh echo through the darkness, a sudden rustle comes from the nearby bushes—and turning her head, Sakura freezes at the sight of her beloved Senpai. The haze of pleasure shatters instantly; she prays desperately that it is only a hallucination, until his voice calls out "...Sakura?" from the shadows. Stripped of every excuse as her true emotions rush back, she weeps uncontrollably and whispers a broken plea: "Senpai... even someone like me... could you still love me?"

第五次圣杯战争落败后，身怀优秀母体资质的间桐樱背负起家族的密令，走上夜街寻找魔力充沛的男性以孕育下一代继承人的“种子”。将对最爱“前辈”的恋慕深埋心底，混入万圣节狂欢人潮的她，换上了大胆裸露的“危险野兽”装扮。伴随一声羞涩生疏的“不给糖就捣蛋”与暗示动作，她被陌生男人一把拽入幽暗无人的后巷；面对男人极具侵略性的雄伟气息，樱在心底默念着“这都是为了间桐家”，强压下对前辈的愧疚，任由对方在暗巷中彻底占有自己。然而，一旦食髓知味，被唤醒的肉体便再也无法用“义务”来粉饰。戴上黑口罩、换上地雷系装束隐瞒真容，她开始在宾馆房间里主动张开双腿迎合男人的索求；在对方无底洞般的欲望一次次浇灌下，最初的使命早已抛诸脑后，只剩下对快感彻底上瘾的沉沦。即便数月后腹中怀上了男人的骨肉，这段扭曲的关系反而变本加厉——挺着孕肚的樱仅戴着一圈项圈，浑身赤裸地被牵往深夜的公园；沉甸甸的双乳喷溅着母乳，随时可能被人撞破的禁忌刺激感让她在夜色下忘我地迎合抽送。就在甜腻的娇喘与肉体拍击声回荡在静谧夜空时，一旁的草丛突然传来异响。下意识转过视线的樱瞬间如坠冰窟——映入眼帘的，竟是她最不想被其看到的“前辈”。快感的迷雾刹那间消散，她拼命祈祷这只是一场幻觉，可那声呼唤着“樱”的熟悉嗓音却将她钉死在残酷的现实里。再也没有半点辩解的余地，彻底恢复自我的樱泪如雨下，带着哭腔挤出了卑微乞求原谅的低语：“前辈……就算是这样的我，你也能爱吗？”
